overview: ADULT CONTENT ADVISORY: this grindhouse double feature simulation contains nudity and other content some viewers might find objectionable. Your night in the sleazy side of town begins with three trailers and a Betty Page short, followed by the first feature, "Diary of a Nudist." An intermission featurette is next, "Naked Fury," followed by the second feature, "Revenge of the Virgins." NOTE: All of the items in this simulation are available separately in the Movie Trailers Collection (Trailers). the Short Format Films Collection (Shorts) and the Feature Films Collection.
